speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with sudden-onset lower abdominal pain. To begin my assessment, could you describe the exact location of the pain and if it has moved to other areas? Also, on a scale of 1 to 10, how severe is the pain right now?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old male. The patient reports the sudden onset of abdominal pain while playing football two hours ago. He has a past medical history significant only for asthma. Additionally, his social history is notable for unprotected sex with four partners in the past month.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: [Appendicitis]

Based on your history of sudden pain starting while playing football and your unprotected recent sexual contacts, I need to confirm if you have a fever or nausea. Additionally, please tell me if the pain has specifically moved to the lower right side of your abdomen, and if pressing on that area makes it hurt more when you let go.
